limitations: Downward withdrawal and insertion distances/axis, body angles and normalized timing are authored guesses where the pack is hand-occluded or below screen; not extracted animation or bones.
Existing clean W150 default paint/UV/geometry preserved; gameplay has lighting/buffs that are not texture reference.
No support-hand geometry, IK, original grip skeleton, detachable power-disc motion or secondary latch/bolt claim.
Partial reload in combat with buffs; no base duration, perk-speed or ammo-credit timing certification.
Actual Minecraft client, native framing, handedness, clearances, ADS, cancellation and performance remain master QA; offline renders and codec acceptance do not prove native visual success.
